Faq.question: Is Joben really free to start?
Faq.answer: Yes. Free includes 1 saved CV, 5 PDF exports, 3 cover letters/month, 3 CV-tailoring runs/month, and 15 bullet rewrites/month.

Faq.question: What is an ATS and what does it do with my resume?
Faq.answer: An ATS (Applicant Tracking System) is the software companies use to receive, store and filter applications. It reads your resume file, extracts the text and splits it into fields (contact details, experience, education, skills), and recruiters search and filter on those fields. If the text is extracted wrongly, your resume can show up incomplete or be missing from recruiter searches.

Faq.question: Why does an ATS misread or reject my resume?
Faq.answer: Common causes are multi-column layouts, tables, text inside images or text boxes, contact details in the header or footer, and unusual section names such as "My journey" instead of "Experience". The parser reads top to bottom, so the order gets scrambled or content disappears. A single-column resume with standard headings avoids most of these problems.

Faq.question: Which keywords should I put in my resume, and where do I find them?
Faq.answer: Take them from the job posting: the skills, tools and certifications listed as requirements or repeated several times. Use the posting's exact wording, for example "Google Analytics" if that is how it appears, and place the word in your experience bullets, where it shows how you used it. Add only what you have actually used.

Faq.question: Are Joben resumes ATS-compatible?
Faq.answer: The template and the PDF export are built for machine reading: a single column, standard section headings and selectable text. Every ATS has its own parser, so no tool can guarantee perfect parsing in all of them. The free scan gives you a 0 to 100 score and the specific points to fix in your resume.

Faq.question: Can I cancel my paid plan anytime?
Faq.answer: Yes. You can manage billing from your account and cancel whenever you want. Your current period remains active until it ends.

Faq.question: How does the 14-day Interview Pass work?
Faq.answer: You pay 39 RON once and get Pro access for 14 days from payment. The pass does not auto-renew, and when it expires your account returns to the Free plan and its limits. Buying another pass while one is active adds the days on top. At checkout you request that access starts immediately and confirm that you lose the 14-day right of withdrawal to the extent the law allows this exception. Details are in the Terms, section 7.

Faq.question: What happens to the data in my resume?
Faq.answer: Your resumes, cover letters and analyses are kept while your account is active and deleted immediately when you delete the account. For AI features, the relevant resume text goes to Anthropic (US) only to generate the result, without your name or email, and Anthropic does not use API data for model training by default. Database access is restricted with row-level security policies and traffic is encrypted with TLS. You can export or delete your data from your account.

sections.title: 1. Who we are
sections.content:
The controller of your data is TETA ABC SRL (tax ID 22404824, trade register J2007001135104), with its registered office at Str. Centrală nr. 169, sat Mărăcineni, Buzău County, postal code 127325, Romania. We provide Joben at joben.eu.

For any question about your data, write to privacy@joben.eu. We have not appointed a Data Protection Officer (DPO) because we do not fall under the cases in Article 37 GDPR, and privacy@joben.eu is our data protection contact point.

We process data under Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR), Romanian Law no. 190/2018, Romanian Law no. 506/2004 on the processing of personal data and the protection of privacy in electronic communications, and Directive 2002/58/EC (ePrivacy).

sections.title: 2. Data we process, purposes and legal bases
sections.content:
Each category of data has a specific purpose and legal basis:

- Account data (email address, first and last name, the sign-in method managed by Clerk, including the name, email and profile picture received from Google if you sign in with Google, chosen language, date and version of the Terms accepted): we create and secure your account and prove acceptance of the Terms. Basis: performance of the contract (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR) and our legitimate interest in proving acceptance of the terms (Art. 6(1)(f)).
- Your content (CVs, cover letters, text pasted into the editor, files uploaded for import, AI analyses and results): we provide the features you created the account for. Basis: performance of the contract.
- Payment data (Stripe customer, subscription and payment IDs, chosen plan, promo codes used): we process payments and keep accounting records. Your card number is entered directly at Stripe and never reaches us. Basis: performance of the contract and the legal obligation to keep accounting records (Art. 6(1)(b) and (c)).
- Free ATS checker without an account: the CV file is analysed in memory and is not saved. We keep the score, the generated report (categories and issues found), the language, a hash of the IP address, a random device identifier from the jb_atsdid cookie and, if you enter it, your email address. Purposes: delivering the report, the daily anti-abuse limit and linking the report to your account if you create one. Basis: steps at your request before a contract (Art. 6(1)(b)) for the report, legitimate interest in preventing abuse (point (f)) and your consent for the follow-up emails described below.
- Service emails (confirmations, reports, invoices, notices about your account or subscription): basis performance of the contract. Follow-up emails to visitors of the ATS checker without an account (up to 2, after 48 hours and after 7 days): basis your consent (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR and Art. 12 of Law no. 506/2004), given when you submit your address. Emails about similar features to users with an account: basis legitimate interest and Art. 12(2) of Law no. 506/2004. Every email contains an unsubscribe link. After you unsubscribe we keep the address on a suppression list so that we respect your refusal.
- Referral programme (the referral code, the link between the person who invites and the person invited, date, Pro days granted): we grant rewards and apply programme limits. Basis: performance of the contract and legitimate interest in preventing abuse.
- Security and diagnostics (technical logs, request identifiers, error messages, the IP address in error reports, IP hash for rate limiting): we protect the service, prevent abuse and fix errors. Basis: legitimate interest (Art. 6(1)(f)) and the security obligation in Art. 32 GDPR.
- Usage analytics and session recordings (PostHog, Google Analytics, Sentry Replay): we understand how the product is used. Basis: your consent only (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR and Art. 4(5) of Law no. 506/2004). Without your consent these tools do not load.
- Feedback and correspondence (the email address and message you send us): we reply and improve the product. Basis: legitimate interest and, where relevant, performance of the contract.

Account data is required to create an account. Without it we cannot provide the service. The optional analytics and the follow-up emails from the ATS checker depend only on your choice.

sections.title: 3. Artificial intelligence processing
sections.content:
When you use an AI feature (CV analysis, job tailoring, cover letter, bullet rewriting, CV file import), we send the relevant text and, on import, the file to Anthropic (the Claude models), our AI provider, solely to generate the result you asked for. We do not send your account data (email, user ID). The CV text does contain whatever you wrote in it, including your name and contact details. Under Anthropic commercial API terms, data sent through the API is not used to train its models. Anthropic deletes API inputs and outputs within 30 days, unless the law or enforcement of its usage policy requires longer retention.

We do not use your CVs to train our own or anyone else's models.

The ATS score, evaluations and suggestions are indicative estimates generated automatically. They produce no legal effects on you, are not sent to employers and are not decisions based solely on automated processing within the meaning of Art. 22 GDPR. You decide what to use from them. Results are generated by an artificial intelligence system and may contain errors, so check them before use.

Please do not include special-category data in your CV (health, religious or political beliefs, ethnic origin, sex life). If you choose to include it anyway, we process it only to provide the service, based on your explicit consent (Art. 9(2)(a) GDPR), which you can withdraw by deleting the information or the account.

sections.title: 4. Who we share data with
sections.content:
We do not sell your data and do not use it for advertising. We share it only with providers acting as processors under data processing agreements, and only as far as necessary:

- Clerk (authentication and account management, USA)
- Supabase (database and storage of account content, AWS US-East region)
- Anthropic (AI processing, USA)
- Stripe (payments; also acts as an independent controller for fraud prevention and its own legal obligations, USA/EU)
- Resend (delivery of transactional and follow-up emails, USA)
- Upstash (rate limiting, cache)
- Vercel (application hosting and aggregated performance metrics without cookies, USA)
- Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (VPS server for parsing CV files and generating PDFs)
- Sentry (error monitoring, EU instance; Sentry Replay only with consent)
- PostHog (product analytics and session recordings, EU instance, only with consent)
- Google Ireland Limited (Google Analytics 4 through Google Tag Manager, only with consent)

We may also disclose data to authorities when the law requires it and to professional advisers (accountant, lawyer) bound by confidentiality.

sections.title: 5. Transfers outside the European Economic Area
sections.content:
Some providers (Supabase, Clerk, Anthropic, Stripe, Resend, Vercel, Google, Oracle) process data in the United States or in other countries outside the EEA. Transfers rely on the European Commission adequacy decision on the EU-US Data Privacy Framework for certified providers or, failing that, on the Standard Contractual Clauses (Decision (EU) 2021/914), supplemented by additional measures where needed.

You can request a copy of the applicable safeguards by writing to privacy@joben.eu.

sections.title: 6. How long we keep data
sections.content:
- Account, CVs, cover letters and AI analyses: while the account is active. When you delete the account in Settings, the data is deleted immediately from the live database, and the provider's backups expire within 30 days.
- Inactive accounts: we delete them after 24 months without sign-in, following a warning email sent 30 days before. Accounts with an active subscription are not part of this deletion.
- ATS scans without an account: 90 days, if not linked to an account. If you create an account, the scan becomes part of your account.
- Sign-up terms acceptance token: 30 days.
- Logs of emails sent, product events and webhook logs: 12 months.
- Feedback messages: 24 months.
- Payment and invoicing records: the periods set by the Romanian Accounting Law no. 82/1991 (between 5 and 10 years), with us and with Stripe.
- Email suppression list (unsubscribed addresses): as long as needed to respect your refusal, only the address and the reason.
- Referral programme: while the accounts involved exist.
- Monitored public posts (section 12): 90 days.
- Error reports (Sentry): about 90 days. Rate limiting data (Upstash): from a few hours up to one month.
- Analytics data: PostHog events 12 months, PostHog session recordings 30 days, Google Analytics data at most 14 months.

sections.title: 7. Your rights
sections.content:
Under the GDPR you have the following rights:

- access to the data we hold (Settings > Export my data gives an instant JSON export)
- rectification of inaccurate data (you can edit it directly in the app)
- erasure of your data (Settings > Delete account, processed immediately)
- restriction of processing
- data portability, in a structured, machine-readable format (the JSON export)
- objection to processing based on legitimate interest
- withdrawal of consent at any time, without affecting the lawfulness of earlier processing (the cookie banner, the unsubscribe link in emails or privacy@joben.eu)
- the right not to be subject to a decision based solely on automated processing with legal effects (Joben makes no such decisions)

For rights that cannot be exercised directly in the app, write to privacy@joben.eu. We reply within one month (extendable by up to two further months for complex requests, with notice to you) and do not charge fees, except for manifestly unfounded or excessive requests. We may ask for proof of identity to protect your data.

You have the right to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority. In Romania this is the National Supervisory Authority for Personal Data Processing (ANSPDCP), B-dul G-ral Gheorghe Magheru nr. 28-30, sector 1, Bucharest, www.dataprotection.ro, anspdcp@dataprotection.ro. If you live in another member state you can contact the authority in your country. You also have the right to apply to the competent courts.

sections.title: 8. Cookies and similar technologies
sections.content: We use strictly necessary cookies and, only with your consent, analytics tools. The full list, the purpose and duration of each, and how to change your choice are in the Cookie Policy, available at /cookies. You can change your choice at any time from the Cookie settings link in the footer of every page.

sections.title: 9. Security
sections.content:
We apply technical and organisational measures appropriate to the risk: encryption in transit (TLS), row-level security (RLS) on tables holding personal data, database access only through server-side services, secret keys kept apart from client code, request rate limiting, hashing of IP addresses used for limiting and mandatory re-authentication when deleting an account.

If a personal data breach occurs that poses a risk to your rights, we notify ANSPDCP within 72 hours and inform you directly when the risk is high (Art. 33 and 34 GDPR). No method of transmission or storage is completely secure, so we cannot guarantee absolute security.

sections.title: 10. Minors
sections.content: Joben is intended for people aged 16 or over, the age of digital consent in Romania. We do not knowingly collect data from anyone under that age. If you believe a minor has given us data, write to privacy@joben.eu and we will delete it.

sections.title: 11. Links to other sites
sections.content: Joben may contain links to third-party sites (for example Stripe, ANPC or career resources). Those sites have their own privacy policies, for which we are not responsible.

sections.title: 12. Monitored public posts
sections.content:
We follow public posts on forums and social platforms where people ask for help with a CV or a job search, so that we can offer useful replies. For these posts we keep the link, the author's public username, the title and the text of the post for 90 days. Basis: legitimate interest (Art. 6(1)(f)). This is the notice required by Art. 14 GDPR for people whose public posts we process.

You can object at any time by writing to privacy@joben.eu, and your post is deleted.

sections.title: 13. Changes to this policy
sections.content: We update this policy from time to time. For significant changes we send an email or show an in-app notice before they apply. The date of the last update appears at the top of the page, and earlier versions are available on request.

sections.title: 14. Contact
sections.content: For requests or questions about personal data write to privacy@joben.eu. For other subjects use hello@joben.eu.

terms.metaDescription: Joben terms and conditions: using the service, plans and payments, the right of withdrawal, AI use, liability and dispute resolution.
terms.heading: Terms and Conditions
terms.intro: Please read these terms before using Joben. They form the contract between you and TETA ABC SRL.
terms.footerSuffix: for details on how we collect and process data.

sections.title: 1. The parties and acceptance of the terms
sections.content:
Joben is an online service provided by TETA ABC SRL (tax ID 22404824, trade register J2007001135104, Str. Centrală nr. 169, sat Mărăcineni, Buzău County, 127325, Romania, hello@joben.eu), referred to below as "Joben" or "we".

By creating an account (ticking acceptance of the Terms and the Privacy Policy) or by using the service, for example the free ATS checker without an account, you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, do not use the service. The contract is concluded in Romanian or English, according to the language of the page you use.

sections.title: 2. Eligibility and account
sections.content:
Joben is intended for people looking for a job and using it for personal purposes. You must be at least 16 to use the service and at least 18 (or have the consent of your legal representative) to buy a paid plan.

Provide accurate information, keep your sign-in details safe and tell us immediately if you suspect unauthorised access. You are responsible for activity in your account. An account is personal and cannot be shared or resold. Joben is for personal use. Creating documents for other people, for a fee or for commercial purposes (for example by recruitment agencies or consultants), requires our written consent. For team use, write to hello@joben.eu.

sections.title: 3. The services
sections.content:
Joben offers a CV and cover letter editor, templates, CV import, ATS checking, AI-assisted analysis, job tailoring and rewriting, and export to PDF or DOCX. Features and monthly limits depend on the plan and are shown on the pricing page.

We may improve, change or withdraw features. For changes that significantly affect your access to or use of a paid service we notify you in advance, and your statutory rights on the conformity of digital services remain unchanged.

sections.title: 4. AI features and your responsibility for content
sections.content:
The AI features use language models provided by Anthropic. Results are generated automatically by an artificial intelligence system, may contain mistakes or unsuitable wording and are informational. Before sending a CV or letter to an employer, check, edit and validate all content.

You are responsible for the accuracy of the information in your CV. Do not use Joben to invent experience, degrees or references. The ATS score is an indicative estimate based on general rules, and each employer and recruiting system works differently. Joben does not assess candidates for employers and does not make hiring decisions.

Details on AI data processing are in the Privacy Policy.

sections.title: 5. No guarantee of employment outcomes
sections.content: Joben is a tool for writing and optimising CVs. We do not guarantee interviews, job offers, passing an ATS filter or any other employment outcome.

sections.title: 6. Plans, prices and payments
sections.content:
Prices are shown in RON on the pricing page and at checkout. Displayed prices are final; the provider is not a VAT payer. Payments are processed by Stripe, and the order confirmation and payment document reach your email.

- The Free plan has the limits shown and involves no payment.
- The 14-day Interview Pass is a one-off payment, with no automatic renewal, and gives Pro access for 14 days.
- The Pro (monthly) and Recruiting Plan (6 months) plans are subscriptions that renew automatically at the end of each billing period, at the price shown at checkout, until cancelled.

You can cancel a subscription at any time in Settings (the Stripe billing portal) or by deleting your account. Cancelling stops future renewals, and access continues until the end of the period already paid. If we change the price of a subscription, we notify you at least 30 days in advance and the new price applies from the next renewal; you can cancel before then.

Monthly AI usage limits in each plan are those shown. Promo codes and Pro days from the referral programme are personal, have no cash value and we may refuse or withdraw them in case of abuse. We may change or end the referral programme, and rewards already granted stay valid.

sections.title: 7. Right of withdrawal and refunds
sections.content:
If you are a consumer, you have the right to withdraw from a contract concluded at a distance within 14 days of its conclusion, without giving a reason (Art. 9 of Government Emergency Ordinance no. 34/2014). To withdraw, send us a clear statement at hello@joben.eu stating your name, your account email and the order. You may use the model withdrawal form in GEO no. 34/2014. We confirm receipt and refund the amounts paid within 14 days at most, using the same payment method.

If you asked for access to start immediately during the withdrawal period, on withdrawal you pay an amount proportionate to the access period used up to then, and the rest is refunded.

For the 14-day Interview Pass, at Stripe checkout you give your express consent to access starting immediately and acknowledge that you lose the right of withdrawal to the extent the law (Art. 16 of GEO no. 34/2014) allows this exception. If the exception does not apply, the rules above apply.

Apart from the right of withdrawal and statutory guarantee rights, amounts paid for an access period that has already started are not refunded. If a paid service did not work as described, write to us and we will fix it or refund proportionately, as the law requires.

sections.title: 8. Acceptable use
sections.content:
You agree not to:

- use Joben for illegal or fraudulent activity or activity that infringes the rights of others
- upload content you have no right to use, or other people's personal data without a legal basis
- attempt unauthorised access, bypass usage limits, overload the service or scrape content automatically
- reverse engineer, resell or redistribute the service or templates as a separate product
- use the AI features to generate illegal, deceptive or harassing content
- create documents for third parties for a fee or for commercial purposes without our written consent

sections.title: 9. Your content
sections.content:
You remain the owner of the rights in the content you create or upload. You grant us a limited, non-exclusive licence, valid while you have an account, solely to process that content to provide the service to you, including sending it to our AI and infrastructure providers. We do not use your content to train AI models.

You warrant that you have the right to use the content you upload. You can export or delete your data at any time in Settings.

Suggestions and ideas you send us about the service may be used by us to improve it, without compensation and without any obligation to implement them. They do not include the content of your CVs.

sections.title: 10. Intellectual property
sections.content: The Joben platform, software, brand, texts, templates and related materials are protected by intellectual property law and belong to Joben or its licensors. You receive a personal, non-exclusive, non-transferable licence to use the service. The documents you export (CVs, letters) can be used freely by you for your job applications.

sections.title: 11. Availability and support
sections.content: We make reasonable efforts to keep the service available, but interruptions may occur for maintenance or for reasons outside our control. We do not offer a guaranteed uptime level. Support is provided at hello@joben.eu, with priority for paid plans.

sections.title: 12. Suspension and termination
sections.content:
You can end the contract at any time by deleting your account in Settings; deletion also cancels an active subscription and is permanent: the data cannot be recovered. Accounts with no sign-in for 24 months are deleted after a warning email sent 30 days before (Privacy Policy, section 6). We may end the service as a whole, with at least 30 days’ notice and a proportionate refund of the paid and unused period.

We may suspend or close an account for a serious breach of these terms, a security risk, fraud or a legal obligation. Where possible we tell you the reason and give you the chance to fix the situation. If termination is due to us or to reasons not attributable to you, we refund the paid and unused period proportionately.

sections.title: 13. Statutory guarantee and limitation of liability
sections.content:
If you are a consumer, you benefit from the statutory rights on the conformity of digital content and digital services (Directive (EU) 2019/770, transposed in Romania). Nothing in these terms restricts them.

We do not exclude or limit liability for acts committed intentionally or with gross negligence, for injury to life, bodily integrity or health, or for any other liability that cannot be limited by law.

Otherwise, to the extent permitted by law, the service is provided "as is" and our liability for direct damages is limited to the amounts you paid in the last 12 months. We are not liable for indirect damages, for the loss of a job opportunity or for decisions taken on the basis of AI suggestions.

We are not liable for non-performance caused by force majeure or by outages of third-party infrastructure providers beyond our reasonable control.

sections.title: 14. Personal data
sections.content: The processing of your personal data is described in the Privacy Policy, and the use of cookies in the Cookie Policy. Both are part of the information given to you and apply alongside these terms.

sections.title: 15. Complaints and dispute resolution
sections.content:
If you have a problem, write to hello@joben.eu and we will try to resolve it amicably. As a consumer you can also turn to the National Authority for Consumer Protection (ANPC, anpc.ro) or to an alternative dispute resolution (ADR) body listed on anpc.ro. These routes are optional and do not affect your right to go to court.

The European online dispute resolution (ODR) platform was closed on 20 July 2025.

sections.title: 16. Governing law and competent courts
sections.content: These terms are governed by Romanian law and European Union law. If you are a consumer, you benefit from the mandatory protection of the law of your country of residence and may bring proceedings before the courts of your country. For users who are not consumers, disputes are resolved by the competent courts at our registered office in Buzău County.

sections.title: 17. Changes to the terms
sections.content: We may change these terms for legitimate reasons, for example legal changes, new features or security measures. For significant changes we notify you by email or in the app at least 30 days before they apply. If you do not accept a change, you can end the contract before it applies, with a proportionate refund of the paid and unused period. Earlier versions are available on request.

sections.title: 18. Final provisions
sections.content: If any provision of these terms is void or unenforceable, the others remain valid. These terms, together with the Privacy Policy and the Cookie Policy, are the entire understanding between us about the service. We may not assign the contract without preserving your rights.

sections.title: 19. Contact
sections.content: General and legal questions: hello@joben.eu. Personal data requests: privacy@joben.eu. Identification details: TETA ABC SRL, tax ID 22404824, trade register J2007001135104, Str. Centrală nr. 169, sat Mărăcineni, Buzău County, 127325, Romania.

cookies.metaDescription: Which cookies and similar technologies Joben uses, what they are for, how long they last and how to change your choice at any time.
cookies.heading: Cookie Policy
cookies.intro: This page lists the cookies and similar technologies (localStorage, sessionStorage) that Joben uses, their purpose and duration. Art. 4(5) of Romanian Law no. 506/2004, Art. 5(3) of Directive 2002/58/EC and the GDPR apply.
cookies.footerSuffix: for how we process personal data.
cookies.necessaryBody: These cookies are needed for the site to work and for features you explicitly request (sign-in, remembering your choices, security). They are used without consent under the ePrivacy exemption and cannot be switched off in the banner. You can block cookies in your browser settings, but some features (sign-in) will stop working.
cookies.analyticsBody:
These tools show us how the product is used so that we can improve it. They load and store data on your device only after you press "Accept all". Until then, Google Tag Manager, Google Analytics, PostHog, Vercel Web Analytics and Sentry Replay are not loaded.

Session recordings (PostHog, Sentry Replay) replay interaction with the page, and text input fields are masked by default.
cookies.marketingBody: We do not use marketing or advertising cookies. The Google consent signals for ads (ad_storage, ad_user_data, ad_personalization) stay permanently denied.

necessaryCookies.name: __clerk_db_jwt
necessaryCookies.purpose: Technical authentication token (mainly used in development environments).

necessaryCookies.name: jb_ref
necessaryCookies.purpose: Remembers the referral code when you open a referral link, so the person who invited you gets the reward if you create an account. Contains only that code.

necessaryCookies.name: jb_atsdid
necessaryCookies.purpose: Random identifier that applies the daily anti-abuse limit of the free ATS checker. Holds no information about your device.

necessaryCookies.name: joben_cookie_consent, joben_cookie_consent_at (localStorage)
necessaryCookies.purpose: Remembers your cookie choice and its date.

necessaryCookies.name: joben_legal_accepted (localStorage)
necessaryCookies.purpose: Briefly remembers acceptance of the Terms during sign-up.

necessaryCookies.name: theme (localStorage)
necessaryCookies.purpose: Remembers the theme you chose (light or dark).

analyticsCookies.name: ph_phc_*_posthog (cookie and localStorage)
analyticsCookies.purpose: Product analytics: pages visited, features used, session recordings.

analyticsCookies.name: _ga, _ga_*
analyticsCookies.provider: Google Analytics 4 via Google Tag Manager (Google Ireland Ltd)

analyticsCookies.name: Vercel Web Analytics
analyticsCookies.purpose: Aggregated page view statistics. Sets no cookies.

sections.title: How to manage your choice
sections.content:
On your first visit a banner appears with the buttons "Reject non-essential" and "Accept all", given equal prominence. You can change or withdraw your choice at any time with the "Cookie settings" link in the footer of any page. Withdrawal stops PostHog collection immediately. Google scripts already loaded in the current page stop on the next page load.

We ask for your choice again after 12 months or if you clear the site data in your browser. You can delete cookies and local data at any time in your browser settings.

sections.title: Technologies without cookies
sections.content: Vercel Speed Insights measures page speed through aggregated metrics, without cookies and without persistent identifiers. The basis is our legitimate interest in keeping the site fast.

sections.title: Transfers and third parties
sections.content: PostHog and Sentry use EU-hosted instances. Google Analytics is provided by Google Ireland Limited and may involve transfers to the USA, covered as described in the Privacy Policy. Details on data processing are in the Privacy Policy.

sections.title: Contact
sections.content: Questions about cookies: privacy@joben.eu.
